sentences.text:
Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case and the custody period of the appellant,
and without expressing any conclusive opinion on the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Accordingly, I.A. No.16972 of 2024 is allowed and it is directed that the remaining jail sentence of the appellant shall remain under suspension subject to the verification for the fact that the amount of fine has been deposited and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the trial Court/concerned Court on 17.12.2024 and thereafter on such other subsequent dates as may be fixed in that behalf.

Author: Chief Justice Bench: Chief Justice  1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR  CRA No. 6477 of 2021  (SANDEEP KUMAR GUPTA Vs THE STATE OF MADH  Dated : 20-01-2023  Ms. Jayanti Thakur - Advocate for appellant.
Mr. Yogesh Dhande - Government Advocate for r I.A. No.21602 of 2022 - is an application filed by the sole appellant seeking suspension of sentence and bail, who was convicted under Section 3(2)
(v) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and sentenced to life imprisonment with fine of Rs.2000/-.
opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__facts: He has also been convicted under Sections 376(1), 306 and 450 of the IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.1000/-, R.I. for 5 years with fine of Rs.1000/- and R.I. for 1 year with fine of Rs.500/-, with default stipulations as mentioned in the impugned judgement.
opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__ANALYSIS:
The case of the prosecution is that the accused committed aforesaid offences and as a result of which the victim ended her life by hanging.
That before the act was committed, she had narrated the incident to P.W-4, who has narrated the manner in which the incident has taken place as narrated by the victim.
Therefore, the same constitutes a very important piece of evidence.
The manner in which the incident has been narrated by the victim to P.W- 4 and P.W-4 narrated the same before the Court, there is nothing worthwhile in the cross-examination to disbelieve the statement of P.W-4.
opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__decision:
For the present it is suffice to note that the appellant would not be entitled for suspension of sentence and bail.
Hence, the application is dismissed.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The case of prosecution is that on 25/03/2018, victim was sexually assaulted by the accused at her house, as a result of which, the victim 2 CRA-6477-2021 committed suicide by handing.
The prosecutrix said that since wrong has been committed upon her, therefore she would not live any more.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that looking to the statement of Smt. Munni Bai (PW-4),
it is seen that evidence of prosecutrix is not natural.
There was no sign of struggle.
Hence, he prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the application and prays for its rejection.
There is no DNA report and there was no medical evidence against the accused regarding rape in Postmortem report.
Prosecutrix has not been held 3 CRA-6477-2021 to be minor by the Court and accused has been acquitted from the charges levelled under Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case and the custody period of the appellant,
and without expressing any conclusive opinion on the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Accordingly, I.A. No.16972 of 2024 is allowed and it is directed that the remaining jail sentence of the appellant shall remain under suspension subject to the verification for the fact that the amount of fine has been deposited and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the trial Court/concerned Court on 17.12.2024 and thereafter on such other subsequent dates as may be fixed in that behalf.
List for final hearing in due course.
